material_command_contract: python proposals/P254-ni-collective-response/attempts/0028/run_physical_environment_material.py --periodic-cells N --output FRESH_DIRECTORY --output-max-bytes 1048576; Root explicitly supplies N, the finite periodic replication count (not an optical cavity volume).

integration_contract.field: UniformMaxwellField: q0 only, no magnetic restoring stiffness. Cell volume and explicit orthonormal Cartesian polarizations determine M=Omega/(8*pi). No initial field value is set.
integration_contract.matter: UPFUniformCoupling.action/derivative_actions/current_action/moments at arbitrary uniform a all use the unanchored physical UPF family. Mean trace outputs are unweighted single spin/k-sector values, never full-material totals.
integration_contract.canonical: joint_canonical_rhs requires extensive electronic dE/da, explicit ionic masses/charges/canonical momenta and same-scalar ionic force at the actual field. It returns Hamilton derivatives and exchange powers; no supplied force is silently certified as same-scalar.
integration_contract.kernel: NonstationaryForceKernel requires FactorPreparation and supplied full-row Heisenberg action/adjoint factors. Both endpoints share an authenticated propagation history and initial raw frame. Bare quasifree path response is not a replacement for PreparedBlochResponse self-consistent screening.
integration_contract.initial_consumer: from_initial_checkpoint validates archived S,D,M,T and directed moments, then returns the stored ordered covariance. Actual CLI authenticates the existing completed checkpoint and admitted XML chain. No material force action is rerun.
integration_contract.sector_normalization: Independent-sector connected covariances use the PRODUCT of source and readout coefficients per sector, not an automatic mean k-weight. Caller must declare complete independent-sector coverage and probe normalization. No implicit spin degeneracy.

resource_contract.oracle: Tiny 3-orbital/8-Fock-state exact SymPy and SciPy fixtures, 4-PW synthetic UPF action, literal angular quadrature; no material allocation.
resource_contract.material: Read existing approximately 25.6 MiB archive and admitted XML/JSON chain; rank 346 small-matrix covariance validation; zero new PW operator applications, no PW frame loaded. Output capped explicitly.
resource_contract.future_kernel_pair: O(P*r^2+r^3) arithmetic, O(r^2+row_block*r) contraction workspace beyond supplied actions. One complex128 full-row factor costs 16*P*r bytes; independent action/adjoint pair costs 32*P*r. Storing every n-time/m-probe endpoint costs up to 32*n*m*P*r bytes; stream/replay instead when available.
